entry.title: Morning in Vinderhoute and Bourgoyen
entry.content:
Slow birding morning, with many birds heard but left unseen (annoying close calls: bramling, common linnet and redwing). Nice encounter with three lovely roe deer, though. Also a soaring sparrowhawk over De Afgraving (not pictured, instead, look at the cute long-tailed tit).

Two roe deer near Vinderhoutse bossen on 16 October 2026.

One long-tailed tit near De Afgraving on 16 October 2026.

entry.title: Birds wing it too
entry.content:
I aim to drop some good birds in this blog if I remember that I created it. Let the blog take flight, like this red-breasted nuthatch (picture courtesy of my wonderful wife)!

A red-breasted nuthatch in Beffe (Rendeux), LX, Belgium on 11 October 2026.
